fx_mapping_note.issue: IBKR CME.php publishes the full-size FX futures fee as a product-GROUP row ('CME Foreign Exchange Product / Forex Futures') whose instrument list uses CME product aliases (EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, ... plus the 6-prefixed code 6H), not the outright symbols 6E/6B/6J/6A.
fx_mapping_note.claim_used: 6E/6B/6J/6A are the outright symbols of CME full-size FX futures covered by that group row (fee 1.60).
fx_mapping_note.basis: Standard CME product-code convention (Euro FX product EUR trades as 6E; British Pound GBP as 6B; Japanese Yen JPY as 6J; Australian Dollar AUD as 6A).
fx_mapping_note.corroboration_status: PARTIAL — (a) the group row itself mixes alias styles and includes a 6-prefixed FX code (6H) verbatim, showing the list spans outright-symbol families; (b) the page's E-mini Forex row (0.85) is independently corroborated by the same-day TradeStation mirror row 'E7 | E-mini Euro FX | $0.85' (A6), validating the page's alias-to-conventional-symbol mapping for the FX family; (c) NO fetched page prints 6E/6B/6J/6A next to 1.60 explicitly.
fx_mapping_note.treatment: Exchange-fee rows for 6E/6B/6J/6A carry mapping_corroboration=PARTIAL; any consumer requiring hard binding should obtain one dated public page listing 6E/6B/6J/6A explicitly (candidate: TradeStation table re-fetch, AMP notice, or CME official fee-schedule PDF — all BLOCKED_TRANSPORT this session).

components_common_to_all_codes.detail: None of the three IBKR offset pages (A2/A3/A4) lists a separate clearing component for these codes; the commissions page rendered no worked example with a clearing line for these codes. All three offset pages publish a give-up surcharge of USD 0.05/contract, 'waived when IBKR is both prime and executing broker'. Standard self-directed flow (no give-up) assumed for the modeled all-in, consistent with the ES precedent; disclosed here.
